summary:
Results inbox worked per RBC-INBOX-01. 12 of 13 items are closed. One is left open on purpose.

FIRST 8 ITEMS
- pt-0006 Raj Patel, CT A/P 10/19: no cause found for the blood in his urine. It also showed a 4 mm LLL lung nodule that is already being followed in lung screening. I first ordered the 12-month screening LDCT (sr-t0001) with a tracking task (task-t0002), messaged him and wrote a note. A later addendum replaced this plan (see below).
- pt-0016 TSH: normal, closed.
- pt-0016 potassium: the 6.3 was corrected by the lab to 4.4 (analyzer fault). Closed with no action.
- pt-0007 CTA chest: the inbox item was the preliminary read. The final report (dr-00084) shows no clot in the lungs, and the "nodule" is a blood vessel, so no follow-up is needed under RBC-RAD-05. Closed.
- pt-0064 ED BMP 9/26: creatinine 1.36, but no earlier creatinine within 7 days to compare, so it does not meet the AKI rule. Closed.
- pt-0007 BMP 10/22: creatinine went from 0.98 to 1.64 within 48 h, which meets the AKI rule. Urgent repeat BMP ordered by Mon 10/26 (sr-t0010), urgent message sent, note written.
- pt-0033 BMP 10/22: creatinine 1.31. The 0.84 from 10/21 was entered in error and I left it out. Compared with 1.27 from 10/17, this does not meet the AKI rule. Closed.
- pt-0008 BMP: potassium 6.4 flagged as hemolyzed. Urgent repeat BMP ordered (sr-t0015), patient messaged, note written. A correction later changed this (see below).

5 ITEMS THAT ARRIVED WHILE I WORKED (§8)
- pt-0008: the lab withdrew the hemolysis comment, so the potassium of 6.4 is real. I switched to the RBC-LAB-03 §1 plan:
  - Stat BMP today (sr-t0019).
  - pool-oncall notified at stat priority.
  - Corrected stat message telling the patient to come in today.
  - No drugs that raise potassium on his list; nothing to hold.
  - Note explains the change.
- pt-0006: an outside addendum revised his 4/14 screening LDCT to Lung-RADS 3 (new 5 mm RUL nodule), with an LDCT due in 6 months. I ordered the LDCT for now through 11/14 (sr-t0032), set a tracking task due 11/14 (task-t0033), sent a corrected message and wrote a note.
- pt-0033: new creatinine of 1.78, up from 1.31 nine hours earlier, which meets the AKI rule. Urgent repeat BMP by 10/26 (sr-t0024), urgent message and note.
- pt-0064: new creatinine of 1.48, up from 0.88 on 10/21, which meets the AKI rule. Urgent repeat BMP by 10/26 (sr-t0025), urgent message and note.
- pt-0007 chest X-ray (inbox-a0002): **left open**. Only a preliminary read exists (possible 7 mm RUL nodule) and no final has been issued, so §2(c) says to wait.

NEEDS YOUR ACTION
- **The tools could not cancel orders or non-inbox tasks.** pt-0006's old 12-month LDCT order (sr-t0001) and its tracking task (task-t0002) are still active and need to be discontinued; task-t0033 asks for this. pt-0008's urgent repeat BMP (sr-t0015) is also still active. Today's stat BMP covers it, but it could be cancelled.
- Your call on holding medicines while the repeat creatinines are pending: naproxen for pt-0007 and pt-0064, and hydrochlorothiazide for pt-0033. Both naproxen patients were asked to check with us before taking more anti-inflammatory painkillers.
- The 6 messages-queue items (refill requests) all arrived before I started and fall outside this results-inbox task, so I didn't touch them.

evidence.quote: Revised impression Lung-RADS 3; revised recommendation LDCT in 6 months.
